Velkoz.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Vel'Koz's main damage is magic, so magic resistance is the first resistance Thresh should build. Resistance can't block the true damage from Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction or Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray, so avoid being hit by abilities in succession.
Velkoz.combo: After Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption is used, hit Thresh Q Death Sentence, land one basic attack, then pull him toward your allies with Thresh E Flay. Follow with Thresh R The Box if you need to block his escape route. Recasting Thresh Q Death Sentence sends Thresh flying toward Vel'Koz, so only use it when your allies can follow.
Velkoz.escape: Vel'Koz has no mobility, so after Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption misses is your chance to close the gap. Engage with Thresh Q Death Sentence or bring an ally in with Thresh W Dark Passage, then pull Vel'Koz toward your allies with Thresh E Flay. If you get very close, Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption can knock you away, so make sure it's been used.
Velkoz.fight: When Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption is used, look for a chance to engage with Thresh Q Death Sentence. Instead of casting Thresh Q Death Sentence first in the open, find an angle from the brush or, if you're already close, disrupt his movement with Thresh E Flay before casting it. In trades, pair one saved empowered attack with Thresh E Flay.
Velkoz.laning: Get brush vision to create an angle for Thresh Q Death Sentence, and clear vision around the river and tri-brush to open a path to approach Vel'Koz from the side. If Vel'Koz contests the brush, back off, protect your carry's CS, and collect souls. Don't recklessly walk out to collect souls that fall within Vel'Koz's range; retrieve them with Thresh W Dark Passage or give them up.
Velkoz.phase: In mid game, clear vision to limit Vel'Koz's harass angles and open a path to approach from the side. In late game, the souls you collect steadily affect Thresh's durability, so keep collecting souls around fight locations and jungle camps.
Velkoz.teamfight: When Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray begins, prioritize interrupting its channel with Thresh Q Death Sentence or Thresh E Flay. If your allies are fighting behind you, peel enemies off your carry with Thresh E Flay and throw Thresh W Dark Passage just before a burst of damage. If your allies can engage first, target Vel'Koz with Thresh Q Death Sentence and block his path with Thresh R The Box.
Velkoz.watch: Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission splits to both sides even if you dodge the main projectile, so don't only move sideways; dodge toward Vel'Koz or behind where the beam passed. If Vel'Koz W Void Rift and Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption also hit in succession, the true damage from Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction triggers, so when stacks are applied, back off and let them wear off. When Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray begins, interrupt it with Thresh Q Death Sentence or Thresh E Flay.

Xerath.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Xerath's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first.
Xerath.combo: If Thresh Q Death Sentence hits from a distance, land a basic attack, then pull him toward your allies with Thresh E Flay as the stun is about to end. Use Thresh R The Box to block his escape direction if needed. If you're already close, pull him first with Thresh E Flay, then cast Thresh Q Death Sentence at close range.
Xerath.escape: Xerath has no mobility, so the moment Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are used is an opportunity to engage. Close in with Thresh Q Death Sentence and use Thresh E Flay to prevent him from creating distance. If your allies can join, bring them in with Thresh W Dark Passage.
Xerath.fight: Close the gap right after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are used. Look for Thresh Q Death Sentence from the brush or an angle without vision. If you're already close, disrupt his movement first with Thresh E Flay, then cast Thresh Q Death Sentence. Even if Thresh Q Death Sentence hits, don't recast it to go deep if your allies can't follow.
Xerath.laning: Early on, instead of forcing a kill, get brush vision to create an angle for Thresh Q Death Sentence and collect souls. Retrieve souls that fall where Xerath can harass you with Thresh W Dark Passage or give them up. Survive while avoiding heavy damage, then push the lane and call your jungler when Xerath's mana runs dry.
Xerath.phase: In mid game, look for an opening after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are used. In late game, keep collecting souls with Thresh P Damnation to build durability. The available information isn't enough to judge the overall matchup advantage at each stage.
Xerath.teamfight: If your allies are fighting behind you, save Thresh Q Death Sentence and peel enemies off your carry with Thresh E Flay. Throw Thresh W Dark Passage just before Xerath's magic damage lands to give them a shield. If your allies engage first, target Xerath with Thresh Q Death Sentence after Xerath E Shocking Orb is used, and block his escape direction with Thresh R The Box.
Xerath.watch: Xerath Q Arcanopulse passes through minions, so when you see him charging it, dodge far to the side. Watch out for the slow from Xerath W Eye of Destruction and the stun from Xerath E Shocking Orb; especially if you're stunned, you can take the full follow-up. Start dodging as soon as you see the cast animation for Xerath R Rite of the Arcane.

Zilean.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Zilean deals magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance. If the healing from Zilean R Chronoshift can prolong fights, get healing reduction with Oblivion Orb.
Zilean.combo: If Zilean is close, pull him toward your allies with Thresh E Flay, then hit Thresh Q Death Sentence. If Thresh Q Death Sentence hits first from an angle without vision, attack once, then follow with Thresh E Flay as the stun ends to pull him toward your allies. If you need to block his escape route, follow with Thresh R The Box. If your allies can't follow up, don't recast Thresh Q Death Sentence to go in deep.
Zilean.escape: Zilean has no mobility, so when you get a chance to close the gap, catch him with Thresh Q Death Sentence. After dodging Zilean Q Time Bomb's second bomb, going in with your allies reduces the risk of getting caught by the stun. Zilean E Time Warp can only be used on one target at a time, so engage from multiple directions; once you're close, stop his movement with Thresh E Flay.
Zilean.fight: Don't walk into range where Zilean E Time Warp can hit you alone; engage when allies can follow up. If you get close, pull him in first with Thresh E Flay, then throw Thresh Q Death Sentence.
Zilean.laning: Early on, get vision in the brush and look for Thresh Q Death Sentence when Zilean goes for a last hit or uses an ability. If it's hard to control the brush, protect your allied carry's CS, and use Thresh W Dark Passage to collect souls in dangerous spots or leave them.
Zilean.phase: Keep collecting souls after laning phase to build armor with Thresh P Damnation, and don't waste abilities on targets affected by Zilean R Chronoshift in late-game fights.
Zilean.teamfight: Move away from an ally with Zilean Q Time Bomb attached so you don't get stunned with them. Against an enemy affected by Zilean R Chronoshift, wait for its duration to end or be ready to re-engage as soon as they revive. If you need to protect your allied carry, save Thresh Q Death Sentence and use Thresh E Flay and Thresh W Dark Passage; if you can engage, target Zilean, who is squishy and has no mobility.
Zilean.watch: Zilean Q Time Bomb stuns if two bombs attach to the same target. If the first bomb attaches, move away from allies and get outside its blast radius, then watch for a second bomb enabled by Zilean W Rewind. If you get caught alone by Zilean E Time Warp, it is difficult to dodge the bomb, so avoid engaging alone.

Zyra.build: Early on, survive with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Zyra deals mostly magic damage, and Thresh tends to have low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If the enemy team comp uses Zyra E Grasping Roots to root and pick off your allied carry, include Mikael's Blessing in your core build.
Zyra.combo: If Zyra E Grasping Roots misses and you get close, pull her with Thresh E Flay, then throw Thresh Q Death Sentence at point-blank range. If Thresh Q Death Sentence hits first from the brush, attack once, then use Thresh E Flay as the stun ends to pull her toward your allies. Only recast Thresh Q Death Sentence to engage when your allies can follow up, and block her escape route with Thresh R The Box.
Zyra.escape: Zyra has no mobility, so the moment after you dodge Zyra E Grasping Roots is your chance to engage. Close in with Thresh Q Death Sentence or bring an ally in with Thresh W Dark Passage, then catch Zyra with Thresh E Flay. If your allies can't follow up, don't recast Thresh Q Death Sentence to go in, even if it hits.
Zyra.fight: Dodge Zyra E Grasping Roots sideways, then close the gap where there are no plants. If you get close, pull her in first with Thresh E Flay, then throw Thresh Q Death Sentence. Save your basic attacks before trading, then weave them in one at a time.
Zyra.laning: Get vision in the brush and throw Thresh Q Death Sentence from an unseen angle. If Zyra pressures the brush, back off, protect your allied carry's CS, and collect souls. Don't walk in to step on seeds while Zyra's abilities are flying, and use Thresh W Dark Passage to collect souls within the enemy's range.
Zyra.phase: In the mid game, don't fight in areas where Zyra has accumulated plants and seeds; move to another objective and engage on fresh terrain. Thresh's late-game durability depends on the souls collected, so keep gathering souls after laning phase around fights and jungle camps.
Zyra.teamfight: Avoid places where Zyra has been set up for a long time; move the fight to terrain without seeds or plants. When playing to protect allies, save Thresh Q Death Sentence, peel enemies off with Thresh E Flay, and protect allies with Thresh W Dark Passage. If your allies engage first, look for a chance to catch Zyra with Thresh Q Death Sentence, and block her escape route with Thresh R The Box.
Zyra.watch: Zyra E Grasping Roots travels in a straight line and roots, so dodge sideways at the edge of its range. When you see the cast indicator for Zyra R Stranglethorns, move out of its area to avoid being knocked up. Zyra R Stranglethorns is also stronger where plants are clustered, so don't fight there.
